column1: # WikiText-2: the refinement techniques of Discrete Beckmann Transport Models added to EqFM, one at a time.
# Base = EqFM with the semigroup loss and no auxiliary loss (W2_eqfm_*_semigroup_noaux). Same model, steps and evaluation.
#   context : partial-context states (a random fraction of the positions is clean and frozen), losses on the other positions
#   ril     : + refinement in the loop from step 3000 (rollouts of the map to the end, data tokens committed, half the batch)
#   ril_sd  : + self-distillation of the last rollout round (soft target, temperature 0.7, copy refreshed every 1000 steps)
